versions.content: Relation of DiagnosticJ1939Spn to Diagnos- ticJ1939FreezeFrame and DiagnosticJ1939ExpandedFreezeFrame It is possible that a given DiagnosticJ1939Spn is referenced by both a Diagnos- ticJ1939FreezeFrame and a DiagnosticJ1939ExpandedFreezeFrame . In other words, the Suspect Parameter Number can be part of a normal freeze frame and, at the same time, an expanded freeze frame.
